source='''def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if row and row[0] != 0 and all(value == row[0] for value in row):
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            if len(top) == len(bottom) and top:
                return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(upper, lower)]
                        for upper, lower in zip(top, bottom)]

    for c in range(width):
        if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid):
            left_width, right_width = c, width - c - 1
            if left_width == right_width and left_width:
                return [[2 if row[i] != 0 and row[c + 1 + i] != 0 else 0
                         for i in range(left_width)] for row in grid]

    raise ValueError("No symmetric divider found")
'''
